coverage_explanation: This executable partial test checks endpoint-report safety: any reported angle must be 0 or 180, and serial output must contain only numeric angle lines, without labels. These checks detect intermediate-angle reports, incorrect endpoint values, and labeled output without imposing an unspecified sweep speed. The requirement provides no step duration or completion deadline, so the test does not require a report within the observation window. Consequently, silence can pass these safety checks; sweep execution, 1-degree stepping, repetition, report ordering, and correspondence between reports and commanded position remain uncovered. The reference implements the complete intended back-and-forth behavior.
assumptions: The explicit circuit fixes the servo signal at pin 9, with servo power connected to 5V and ground; bench wiring defaults are not needed.
Serial uses the supplied 9600 baud and line-or-idle framing.
No sweep speed, step delay, startup deadline, or sweep-completion deadline is specified. The 180-second horizon is an observation budget, not an asserted completion deadline.
The instruction to repeat is interpreted as continued back-and-forth sweeps with an endpoint report after each completed sweep.
The reference chooses a 15 ms step delay, which is permitted but is not required by the checks.
These serial safety checks operate on captured report text and do not establish that Servo.read() was used internally.

checks.requirement_quote: Print only the number when printing the angle.
When the moving is finished, print the current servo position
